# @aponiajs/common

> Platform-neutral decorators and public contracts for AponiaJS modules, dependency injection, HTTP routes, and WebSocket gateways.

This package records metadata and declares contracts. It never builds a module graph, a route, or a container, and it depends on no platform, so `@aponiajs/core` and `@aponiajs/platform-elysia` can consume the same declarations. Install it with `bun add @aponiajs/common`.

## What this package exports

- [Module, Controller, Injectable, Inject](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/decorators/decorators.ts): module, controller, and injection decorators.
- [Get, Post, Put, Patch, Delete, Head, Options](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/decorators/decorators.ts): HTTP method decorators, each accepting an optional route schema.
- [getModuleMetadata, getControllerMetadata, getRouteMetadata, getConstructorDependencies](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/decorators/decorators.ts): read the metadata a decorator recorded.
- [Body, Query, Param, Headers, Cookie, Store, Req, Set, Res, Status, Ctx](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/route-parameters.ts): parameter decorators, each optionally naming one property.
- [routeParameterKinds, getRouteParameterMetadata](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/route-parameters.ts): the parameter kind constants and their metadata reader.
- [Validation, resolveRouteValidator, getValidationMetadata](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/validation.ts): binds one validator to a validation-model class used in a route schema.
- [routeSchemaSlots, isStandardSchema, isRouteResponseSchemaMap](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/route-schema.ts): the schema slot names and the validator guards the platform uses.
- [defineModule](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/modules/module.ts): the descriptor-first alternative to `@Module()`.
- [provideValue, provideClass, provideFactory, provideAlias](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/providers/provider.ts): provider descriptors for hand-written modules.
- [createToken, tokenName](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/tokens/token.ts): explicit injection tokens.
- [AponiaError](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/errors/aponia-error.ts): every framework failure, carrying one code and frozen structured details.
- [ConsoleLogger, Logger](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/logging/console-logger.ts): the default structured logger.
- [renderLogValue](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/logging/log-value.ts): the text a logged value is stated as, and `[unrenderable]` for a value it cannot state.
- [WebSocketGateway, SubscribeMessage, MessageBody, ConnectedSocket, WebSocketServer](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/websockets/websocket-gateway.ts): platform-neutral gateway decorators.
- [getWebSocketGatewayMetadata, getWebSocketMessageMetadata, getWebSocketParameterMetadata, getWebSocketServerProperties](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/websockets/websocket-gateway.ts): the gateway metadata readers.

## Public types

- [AponiaErrorCode](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/errors/aponia-error.types.ts): the closed union of framework failure codes.
- [RouteContext, RouteSchema, RouteValidator, RouteCookie, RouteResponseSchema, InferValidatorOutput](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/route-schema.types.ts): the platform-neutral handler context and route schema contract.
- [RouteSchemaSlot, RouteResponseSchemaMap, RouteResponseSettings, NativeSchema](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/route-schema.types.ts): the schema slots and the structural match for platform-native JSON Schema validators.
- [RouteParameterKind, RouteParameterMetadata](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/route-parameters.types.ts): parameter decorator metadata.
- [ValidationModelClass, ValidationMetadata, RouteValidatorInput](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/routing/validation.types.ts): the validation-model contract.
- [ModuleDefinition, DefinedModule, ModuleOptions, DynamicModule](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/modules/module.types.ts): the frozen module descriptor.
- [Provider, ClassProvider, ValueProvider, FactoryProvider, AliasProvider, ProviderScope](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/providers/provider.types.ts): provider contracts.
- [InjectionToken, ClassToken, Constructor, TokenValue, TokenValues](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/tokens/token.types.ts): token contracts.
- [ModuleMetadata, ControllerMetadata, RouteMetadata, ModuleClass, ModuleImport, ModuleProvider, RequestMethod](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/decorators/decorators.types.ts): decorator inputs and recorded shapes.
- [LoggerService, LogLevel, ConsoleLoggerOptions](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/logging/logger.types.ts): logger contracts.
- [WsResponse, OnGatewayInit, OnGatewayConnection, OnGatewayDisconnect](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/websockets/websocket-gateway.types.ts): gateway response and lifecycle contracts.
- [WebSocketGatewayMetadata, WebSocketGatewayOptions, WebSocketMessageMetadata, WebSocketParameterKind, WebSocketParameterMetadata](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/websockets/websocket-gateway.types.ts): gateway metadata shapes.
- [ControllerDefinition](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/controllers/controller.types.ts): the platform-neutral controller descriptor.
- [OnModuleInit, OnApplicationBootstrap, OnModuleDestroy, BeforeApplicationShutdown, OnApplicationShutdown](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/common/src/lifecycle/lifecycle.types.ts): the five moments a provider can hook, read from the instance by the platform.

- [Errors](../../docs/learn/10-errors.md): which failures are raised, when, and how to assert on them.
